prompts.prompt: Open my TODO Board and help me prioritize overdue, blocked, and in-progress work.
prompts.purpose: Demonstrates the real XMemo TODO Board inline Widget with current focus, status counts, and direct task actions.

prompts.prompt: Open my Ledger and show this month's net flow, income, expenses, and largest category.
prompts.purpose: Demonstrates the real XMemo Ledger inline Widget with an at-a-glance monthly financial summary and direct actions.

prompts.prompt: Open my Project Workspace and show the current focus, blockers, and related TODOs.
prompts.purpose: Demonstrates the real XMemo Project Workspace inline Widget with project health, current attention, and a direct workspace action.

submission_notes: Enter only the prompt text in the submission form; ChatGPT adds the XMemo plugin mention automatically.
Upload the matching screenshot for each prompt.
Each screenshot is a 706 px-wide PNG within the portal's accepted 400–860 px height range: TODO Board 706 x 479, Ledger 706 x 479, and Project Workspace 706 x 415.
The screenshots render the current repository's real XMemo React Widgets with typed synthetic fixtures; they contain no private user data.
No ChatGPT UI, browser chrome, user prompt, marketing overlay, decorative preview background, or extra embedded localization copy is included.
